changes: Type "/" in a Codex agent's message box to run its commands (/compact, /review, /init, /status, /diff…) or "$" to use one of its skills, as you can for Claude.
Pictures you paste into Codex now show in the conversation, and an agent's edits open to a coloured diff of what changed, each file named.
Attach any file to a message (a PDF, a log, a spreadsheet), not just images; the agent reads it on your Mac.
Type "@" in a message box to name one of the agent's files; it reads the file when your message arrives.
When an agent looks at several images in a row, they now show as one step with the pictures side by side, instead of one step per picture.

Type "/" in a Claude agent's message box to run its commands: /compact, /context, /rename, your skills and more. /usage and /status show their answer right here, and a thread follows /clear to the new conversation.
Speak your messages: tap the mic beside the message box and Agentman writes out what you say (sign in to Celery in Agentman for Mac › Settings › Keys first). Text is a little larger throughout.
Agent threads are calmer: the agent's work sits in small grey pills under its words, background tasks say what finished, and the mode moved down beside the model so the header is one row.
Pictures you send Agentman now show, and open full screen when tapped. You can paste a screenshot into Agentman's box, and close (or swipe away) its news cards.

Notifications now come from Agentman while it's on: its replies, briefs and cards, and a tap opens it. To hear from agents directly too, turn on "Hear from every agent" in Settings › Notifications, or "Notify me about this agent" from an agent's menu.
Messages you send while Claude is working now stay in the chat, marked Pending, until Claude reads them. Tap Send now to have it read them straight away.
Italic text in replies is now actually italic, including inside bold text and headings.
Replies render markdown more faithfully: nested lists, task checkboxes, strikethrough, tappable bare links, and formatting inside links and quotes.
Links in an agent's reply now open even when they are in bold, instead of showing as raw [text](url).
The update prompt and Settings now show the app's version, like 0.2.0 (27).
When a newer version of the app or of agentman on your Mac is out, Agentman tells you once, with what's new and how to update. Settings → Versions shows both.
Alerts now have their own sounds: a ping when an agent needs you and a chime when one finishes, even with the app closed.
